market.question: Ethereum ETF approved by May 31, 2024?
market.resolutionText:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any spot Ethereum ETF receives approval from the SEC by May 31, 2024, 11:59:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be information from the SEC, however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

label.whatHappened: Market (~$13.2M volume) resolved YES on May 23, 2024 after the SEC approved the 19b-4 filings for multiple spot Ether ETFs. The outcome was briefly disputed: NO voters argued 'approved' required the S-1 registration statements (needed before the ETFs could actually trade), not just the 19b-4 approvals. It resolved YES after dispute, but exposed the definitional ambiguity in 'approved.'
